Your whole fortress on one dashboard tile, with one log for every app. Joining takes twelve words, and you never type an address.

## ✨ Added
- A dashboard tile with a row per app of your fortress: its state, what needs you, what it is working on and its version. An app that runs on several devices still gets one row.
- One log with the lines of every app, newest at the bottom. Click an app, or its button above the log, and the log shows only its lines.
- Open in the tile header shows the chosen app's status window, with what needs you, what it is working on, what comes next and its latest log lines. For the app's own pages, open it in BombVault, KnightLoader or ArrowLoop, wherever you are.
- Your other apps can open TollRoll's status window too. It shows TollRoll's version, its next check and a log of what it told you.
- Join your fortress with its phrase under Settings → Utilities → TollRoll. Every app in the same fortress then shows up by itself, whether it runs on this server or on another device.
- Your other apps show TollRoll with its own logo.
- When your fortress moves to a new phrase, TollRoll follows on its own and stays the same member, so no duplicate shows up. If it can't, the settings page asks for the new words.
- If another app takes TollRoll out of the fortress, the settings page says so, after a restart too, and lets it back in with the current phrase.
- Take any other member out of the fortress right from the settings page. TollRoll asks first, then points you to an app where you change the phrase, because the old one would still let it back in. Until you do, a quiet line names who you took out.
- Four views in the tile header: everything, the apps alone, the log alone and a map of every device with its apps. The tile keeps your view and your pick of apps on the server, so every browser finds it the way you left it.
- Notifications through Unraid, Apprise or Matrix when an app stops answering, answers again or newly needs you. Each one goes out once, so a long outage does not fill your inbox.
- Every setting is saved the moment you change it. Only the twelve words wait for the Join button.
- TollRoll keeps only the keys made from your phrase, never the phrase itself. The browser talks to the Unraid WebGUI alone, and the service behind it opens no network port.

## 🎨 Design
- Each row wears the app's own logo and colour from its status report, or its first letter when the report has none. A logo is checked and only ever drawn as an image, so nothing in it can run.
- The log keeps its dark terminal look on every Unraid theme.
- The settings page has the same tabs as our other Unraid plugins: General, Notifications, Fortress and Info, with the version, help and a way to say thanks.
- The fortress card is the same in every one of our Unraid plugins and has its own tab, right above Info. It shows each app with its logo, how it runs and its version, and Open tells you how a plugin is doing.

## 🌐 Translations
- Every text in all 26 languages Unraid offers. Texts from your apps arrive in your language too, as far as each app has them.
